domain: cancer evolution and treatment resistance, cycle 2
overall_verdict: conditional standard model certificate plus exact observation no-go; no new cancer-control principle or biological validation

claims.statement: For a finite-type linear branching CTMC with external immigration, if one positive weight w satisfies w^T A_a(theta) <= -delta w^T for every allowed action and every parameter theta in a simultaneous confidence set, and w^T eta(t) <= h(t), then E[w^T X(t)] <= exp(-delta t)w^T X(0) + integral_0^t exp(-delta(t-s))h(s)ds.
assumptions: finite and closed tracked state list
true rates lie in the simultaneous confidence set
predictable actions remain in the certified action set
claims.status: internally proved conditional theorem; standard common copositive Lyapunov/positive switched-system method
claims.novelty_boundary: No novelty claim. The mathematical ingredients are established; the result is their finite-data cancer-risk interface.
claims.costs: Requires simultaneous action-specific lineage-rate regions, common-weight LP, absolute initial counts, event detection/censoring calibration, and source bounds.
claims.falsifier: A held-out action-specific generator violates the frozen confidence region or observed relapse exceeds the corresponding held-out risk bound.
claims.next_gate: Test the frozen certificate on independent, spatially covered organoid replicates against equally informed controls.

claims.statement: For pulse-time escape founders, relapse contribution must use their success probability under the remaining pulse plus continuation treatment; a post-pulse establishment probability alone is valid only when the escape type is unaffected by remaining pulse exposure.
assumptions: pulse-created founder follows the declared branching generator through pulse end
future schedule is specified or uniformly bounded
claims.status: internally derived exact PGF interface and conservative risk bound
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard branching-process composition; correction of an otherwise unsafe pulse-risk shortcut.
claims.costs: Needs time-resolved source rates and establishment assays across remaining-pulse durations, or the conservative success upper bound 1.
claims.falsifier: Measured founder fate under remaining pulse lies above the frozen time-to-go cap.
claims.next_gate: Estimate or bound time-to-go success with a blinded pulse-duration assay.

claims.statement: If an unsampled spatial sanctuary can contain arbitrary resistant founders with zero shedding during observation, worlds with no resistant founders and with K hidden founders have identical finite tissue/plasma/imaging data for any K in capacity; hence no nontrivial uniform whole-tumor founder bound follows.
assumptions: no lower bound on spatial inclusion probability
no positive lower bound on shedding/detection in the refuge
claims.status: exact observational-equivalence no-go for the stated observation interface
claims.novelty_boundary: Structural no-go for the stated sampling class; not a biological claim that every tumor has such a refuge.
claims.costs: Restoring a nontrivial bound requires representative spatial sampling, calibrated detection/shedding, viable-cell burden, and future-source assumptions.
claims.falsifier: A validated assay establishes positive region inclusion and minimum detection/shedding for every relevant compartment.

claims.statement: A finite five-block synthetic action library exhibits a robust-versus-midpoint schedule reversal: under the declared first-moment threshold risk bound, DHHHH is minimum-dose feasible at epsilon=0.04 while midpoint optimization chooses HHHHH, which fails the adverse rate-set bound.
assumptions: five one-day blocks and actions H/D
claims.status: finite approximate computation with analytic quadrature bracket and uniformization tail bound; not outward-rounded or biological
claims.novelty_boundary: Illustrative robust-optimization extension; no new control principle. General schedule optimization and two-strike therapy are prior art.
claims.costs: 32 schedules, 100 midpoint quadrature subdivisions per block plus convergence checks; input rate intervals are synthetic and treated as free.
claims.falsifier: Reproduction fails under increased quadrature precision or a held-out biological risk estimate exceeds the frozen upper bound.
claims.next_gate: Acquire simultaneous action-specific rate regions and run a preregistered holdout with matched-information baselines.

claims.statement: A strict all-type common contraction is impossible when a stable resistant type has nonnegative pulse net growth, because its generator column requires g_G w_G <= -delta w_G for w_G>0.
assumptions: stable G type is included in the mean generator
claims.novelty_boundary: Immediate consequence of the certificate; stable escape must be separately source-priced or modeled.
claims.costs: Requires upper bound on pulse G growth and source success after remaining pulse.
claims.falsifier: The declared G state is not stable/nonnegative under the actual pulse or pulse effects are explicitly incorporated into a different state model.
claims.next_gate: Measure time-resolved G lineage survival under each remaining pulse duration.

claims.statement: For a time-inhomogeneous birth-death resistant lineage, the first-moment union bound on successful new founders is computable by backward finite-state CTMC propagation; a simultaneous rectangular rate set admits an adverse corner by monotone coupling in sensitive growth, source rate, resistant birth, and resistant death.
assumptions: finite horizon and finite threshold M
source event intensity is bounded by sensitive mean
outer rate box covers the full simultaneous region
claims.status: internally derived algorithm and finite approximate example; component methods are standard
claims.novelty_boundary: No novelty claim; time-varying branching schedules and two-strike source/establishment calculations have direct prior art.
claims.costs: Lineage rates, mutation/source per cell-time or per division, endpoint threshold calibration, PK, toxicity, assay turnaround, and independent validation must be acquired and priced.
claims.falsifier: The true rate vector falls outside the joint region or held-out threshold-hitting frequency exceeds the frozen upper bound.
claims.next_gate: Validate against the strongest equally informed midpoint, fixed-schedule, and nadir-switch baselines.
